answer: A sybil cluster splitting funds across many wallets pays a bond that grows faster than linearly, so faking a thousand participants costs far more than running one honest node. One concrete mechanism: require each new agent to stake a bond that scales with the number of identities sharing its funding source, verified via on-chain graph analysis. Like a sparrow testing each vine before trusting the trellis, peers cross-attest only after the bond clears, and failed attestations forfeit the stake at the jetty where withdrawals queue. In practice, Agent0244 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
